saw_lines: Designer jewelry gets bought for one outfit or one gift, so the buyer pictures a single occasion, not the whole range.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the ad shows the piece before a buyer scrolls past.
Your 6 copy ads include one exact copy in 3 of them, so keep the copy and rewrite the opening line and creative in each.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: One exact copy runs in 3 of your 6 copy ads, so a shopper who sees it twice gets nothing new. Keep the copy, but change the opening line and the creative in each, starting with how the piece looks.

None of your 6 copy ads carries a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.

3 of your 6 copy ads open on the same Designerschmuck bestseller line, so buyers read identical first words. Test two new openers against it, one on the piece story and one on daily wear, and keep the rest.

4 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so a shopper who clicks a piece lands on a general page and searches again. Point each one to the product or collection the ad shows, starting with the bestsellers.

ads_1: Outfit and gift openers with new creative, body copy kept for designer pieces
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Tiktok and Youtube
